text:
Emily W: Quick sync — I want to propose a lightweight redispatch + dynamic reweighting experiment to reduce tenant starvation and make abuse scoring more actionable. Thinking short windows (10-30s) and fast reweights instead of long leases.

Raj P: +1. Long leases are causing head-of-line blocking for low-volume tenants. Quick question: how do we avoid oscillation when many tenants spike simultaneously?

Sarah L: Concerned about oscillation too. If we reweight too aggressively we might starve baseline traffic. We should add damping (exponential decay) and a min-share floor per tenant.

Darren M: Proposed knobs: window=20s, decay=0.6, min_share=0.005. Also track a short-term EWMA of tokens/sec and backlog-length. If backlog > 0 and token_rate drops we boost weight proportionally.

Emily W: That sounds reasonable. For abuse scoring, instead of a binary block, we should publish an "inflation" factor that reduces effective tokens for high-score tenants, so quotas adapt without hard fails.

Raj P: I like the inflation idea. We can compute effective_weight = base_weight / (1 + alpha * abuse_score). alpha tunable per tier. Default alpha=2.0?

Sarah L: Add safeguards: cap inflation to a 4x penalty and run a probation flag so we don't permanently punish noisy clients during transient failures.

Kevin H: Telemetry requests: please add metrics: tenant_redispatch_count, tenant_reweight_event{tenant_id,old_weight,new_weight}, abuse_inflation_applied, probations_started. Need these for rollout dashboard.

Darren M: Implementation sketch: reweight controller reads per-tenant EWMA and abuse_score stream, emits ReweightEvent to control plane; edge proxies subscribe and apply new weights on next dispatch tick. Use a governor to limit reweights/sec to avoid thundering herd.

Emily W: Sample pseudocode for controller backoff:
```
if backlog > 0 and tokens_per_sec < target:
  candidate = clamp(base * (1 + backlog_scale), min_share, max_share)
  new_weight = blend(old_weight, candidate, decay)
  emit_reweight(tenant, new_weight)
end
```

Raj P: For safety, make a dry-run flag in the controller so we can write events to telemetry without affecting runtime. Roll out dry-run -> soft-apply (probation only) -> full apply.

infra-bot: scheduled: reweight-controller v1 smoke deploy to staging at 2026-04-02T15:30:00Z, canary=5%

Sarah L: For tests, create a counterfactual simulator that replays traces with and without inflation to check latency and fairness delta. Also include synthetic abusive patterns (burst loops).

Kevin H: I'll add a dashboard PR template with the new metrics and a follow-up RFC section for rollout plan.

Emily W: OK action items: Darren to prototype controller + dry-run, Raj & Sarah to define decay/alpha tuning matrix, Kevin to add telemetry/dashboards, I'll draft the short RFC. Sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
